# Consensus rules

The rules of the `bitcoin` consensus value, in the order validation runs them. A rejection's `#:rule` is one of these names, or one of the script-level rules below.

| Rule | Scope | What it checks |
|---|---|---|
| `inputs-nonempty` | tx | A transaction spends at least one coin. |
| `outputs-nonempty` | tx | A transaction creates at least one output. |
| `output-range` | tx | Every output amount, and their total, lies between 0 and 21M BTC. |
| `duplicate-inputs` | tx | No coin is spent twice by one transaction. |
| `locktime-final` | tx | A transaction with nLockTime set waits until a block above that height, unless every input's nSequence is final. |
| `input-exists` | input | Each input spends an unspent coin on this chain. |
| `coinbase-maturity` | input | A coinbase output is spendable once it is 100 blocks deep. |
| `value-balance` | tx | Inputs add up to at least the outputs; the difference is the fee. |
| `sequence-lock` | input | BIP68: an input whose nSequence encodes a relative lock waits that many blocks after its coin confirmed. |
| `witness-script` | input | Each input's witness satisfies the script of the coin it spends. |

## Script-level rules

witness-script failures name a more specific rule: one of these, or the opcode that failed (see opcodes).

| Rule | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `bad-opcode` | The script uses an opcode this consensus does not define. |
| `cleanstack` | A segwit script must finish with exactly one item on the stack. |
| `eval-false` | The script finished with false on top, e.g. a CHECKSIG whose signature did not verify; #:cause says why. |
| `key-path-sig` | A taproot key-path spend needs a valid signature by the internal key; #:cause says why. |
| `stack-underflow` | An opcode needed more stack items than there were. |
| `taproot-commitment` | The control block and leaf script do not commit to the taproot output key. |
| `unbalanced-conditional` | IF/ELSE/ENDIF do not match up. |
| `unsupported` | The model does not implement this feature yet (e.g. time-based locks). |
| `unsupported-spend` | The model does not implement this kind of output yet. |
| `witness-program-mismatch` | The witness does not fit the output's witness program: wrong item count, or the script does not hash to the program. |

## Proposal rules

| Rule | Opcode | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ctv-template-mismatch` | `ctv` | The spending tx does not match the CTV template; #:fields names what differs, #:expected and #:got show the template's and the tx's values. |
